_about: The message box shown at Skyrim's main menu until the player has accepted it: MORDHAU is not started by the mod before that. The answer is kept in %LOCALAPPDATA%\MordhauSkyrim\understood.txt with the version below; raising the version asks again (for a changed text). play-test note, 2026-10-15.
body:
MORDHAU x Skyrim - please read before the first start

This mod starts your own MORDHAU, offline, in a window behind Skyrim, and runs a script inside it.

MORDHAU is an online game with anti-cheat. Nobody - the author included - can promise how the anti-cheat treats this mod. If you are not willing to take any risk with your MORDHAU account, do not use it.

- Never play MORDHAU online from the mod's MORDHAU window.
- Before playing MORDHAU online, make sure there is no file named dwmapi.dll (or dwmapi.dll.old) in MORDHAU's Mordhau\Binaries\Win64 folder.
- The mod is experimental. Use a new save.

MORDHAU is not started until you choose "I understand".
decline: Not now - play Skyrim without it
